launchd_user_writable_programs.query: SELECT path, label, program, program_arguments, run_at_load, keep_alive, username FROM launchd WHERE (path LIKE '/Users/%/Library/LaunchAgents/%' OR path LIKE '/Library/LaunchAgents/%' OR path LIKE '/Library/LaunchDaemons/%') AND (program LIKE '/Users/Shared/%' OR program LIKE '/tmp/%' OR program LIKE '/private/tmp/%' OR program LIKE '/var/tmp/%' OR program LIKE '%/.%' OR program_arguments LIKE '%/Users/Shared/%' OR program_arguments LIKE '%/tmp/%' OR program_arguments LIKE '%/.%' OR program_arguments LIKE '%curl %' OR program_arguments LIKE '%osascript%' OR program_arguments LIKE '%base64%' OR program_arguments LIKE '%python% -c %' OR program_arguments LIKE '%bash -c %' OR program_arguments LIKE '%sh -c %');
launchd_user_writable_programs.description: Launch agents/daemons running from temporary, shared or hidden locations, or wrapping shell/osascript/curl one-liners (Adload, Shlayer, AMOS, Cuckoo persistence).

launchd_hidden_plists.query: SELECT path, label, program, program_arguments, run_at_load FROM launchd WHERE name LIKE '.%' OR label LIKE '.%';

launchd_unsigned_programs.query: SELECT l.path AS plist, l.label, l.program, s.signed, s.identifier, s.team_identifier, s.authority FROM launchd l JOIN signature s ON s.path = l.program WHERE l.program != '' AND l.program NOT LIKE '/System/%' AND l.program NOT LIKE '/usr/libexec/%' AND s.signed = 0;
launchd_unsigned_programs.description: Launchd jobs whose executable is not code-signed.

startup_items.query: SELECT name, path, args, type, source, status, username FROM startup_items;
startup_items.description: Login items, launch agents/daemons and other startup items (diffed by the daemon against its baseline).

launchd_overrides.query: SELECT label, key, value, uid, path FROM launchd_overrides;

crontab.query: SELECT event, minute, hour, day_of_month, month, day_of_week, command, path FROM crontab;
crontab.description: cron jobs (rare on macOS, a classic persistence spot).

processes_deleted_binary.query: SELECT pid, name, path, cmdline, parent, uid FROM processes WHERE on_disk = 0 AND path != '';
processes_deleted_binary.description: Running processes whose executable was deleted from disk (droppers that self-delete).

processes_from_temp_or_shared.query: SELECT pid, name, path, cmdline, parent, uid FROM processes WHERE path LIKE '/Users/Shared/%' OR path LIKE '/private/tmp/%' OR path LIKE '/tmp/%' OR path LIKE '/private/var/tmp/%' OR path LIKE '/private/var/folders/%/T/%' OR path LIKE '%/.%';
processes_from_temp_or_shared.description: Processes executing from temporary, shared or hidden paths.

processes_unsigned.query: SELECT p.pid, p.name, p.path, s.signed, s.identifier, s.team_identifier FROM processes p JOIN signature s ON s.path = p.path WHERE p.path != '' AND p.path NOT LIKE '/System/%' AND p.path NOT LIKE '/usr/%' AND p.path NOT LIKE '/bin/%' AND p.path NOT LIKE '/sbin/%' AND s.signed = 0;
processes_unsigned.description: Running unsigned executables outside the system volume.

listening_ports_unsigned.query: SELECT DISTINCT lp.port, lp.protocol, lp.address, p.pid, p.name, p.path FROM listening_ports lp JOIN processes p USING (pid) JOIN signature s ON s.path = p.path WHERE lp.port != 0 AND lp.address NOT IN ('127.0.0.1', '::1') AND s.signed = 0;
listening_ports_unsigned.description: Unsigned processes listening on non-loopback addresses (backdoors, reverse shells).

kernel_extensions_third_party.query: SELECT name, version, path FROM kernel_extensions WHERE name NOT LIKE 'com.apple.%' AND name != '__kernel__';

system_extensions.query: SELECT identifier, version, state, category, team, bundle_path, mdm_managed FROM system_extensions;
system_extensions.description: Installed system extensions (network filters, endpoint security clients, drivers).

authorization_plugins.query: SELECT label, plugin, mechanism, privileged, entry FROM authorization_mechanisms WHERE plugin NOT IN ('builtin', 'loginwindow', 'HomeDirMechanism', 'MCXMechanism', 'CryptoTokenKit', 'PKINITMechanism', 'KerberosAgent', 'LocalAuthentication', 'SecurityAgentHelper', 'DiskUnlock', 'TeamViewerAuthPlugin');
authorization_plugins.description: Non-default authorization plug-ins (credential theft at login).

sudoers.query: SELECT source, header, rule_details FROM sudoers WHERE rule_details LIKE '%NOPASSWD%';

authorized_keys.query: SELECT u.username, a.algorithm, a.comment, a.key_file FROM users u CROSS JOIN authorized_keys a USING (uid);

chrome_extensions.query: SELECT u.username, c.browser_type, c.name, c.identifier, c.version, c.from_webstore, c.permissions, c.path FROM users u CROSS JOIN chrome_extensions c USING (uid);
chrome_extensions.description: Chromium-family browser extensions (flag the ones not from the Web Store or with broad permissions).

safari_extensions.query: SELECT u.username, s.name, s.identifier, s.version, s.developer_id, s.path FROM users u CROSS JOIN safari_extensions s USING (uid);
safari_extensions.description: Safari extensions (adware such as Pirrit/Bundlore installs rogue ones).

browser_plugins.query: SELECT u.username, b.name, b.identifier, b.version, b.path, b.disabled FROM users u CROSS JOIN browser_plugins b USING (uid);

hidden_files_in_shared_and_tmp.query: SELECT path, size, mtime, mode FROM file WHERE (path LIKE '/Users/Shared/.%' OR path LIKE '/private/tmp/.%' OR path LIKE '/private/var/tmp/.%' OR path LIKE '/Library/Application Support/.%') AND type = 'regular';
hidden_files_in_shared_and_tmp.description: Hidden regular files in shared/temporary locations (common AMOS / Adload / XLoader staging spots).

etc_hosts_overrides.query: SELECT address, hostnames FROM etc_hosts WHERE address NOT IN ('127.0.0.1', '::1', '255.255.255.255', 'fe80::1%lo0') AND hostnames NOT IN ('localhost', 'broadcasthost');
etc_hosts_overrides.description: /etc/hosts entries redirecting names to other addresses (hijack of update or banking domains).

dns_resolvers.query: SELECT type, address, options FROM dns_resolvers WHERE type = 'nameserver';
dns_resolvers.description: Configured DNS resolvers (unexpected resolver = DNS hijack; compared with the Parabellum DNS state).

security_posture.query: SELECT (SELECT assessments_enabled FROM gatekeeper) AS gatekeeper, (SELECT enabled FROM sip_config WHERE config_flag = 'sip') AS sip, (SELECT global_state FROM alf) AS firewall, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM disk_encryption WHERE encrypted = 1) AS encrypted_volumes;
security_posture.description: Gatekeeper, SIP, application firewall and FileVault status.

xprotect_reports.query: SELECT name, user_action, time FROM xprotect_reports;

apps_unsigned.query: SELECT a.name, a.path, a.bundle_identifier, s.signed, s.team_identifier FROM apps a JOIN signature s ON s.path = a.path WHERE a.path LIKE '/Applications/%' AND s.signed = 0;
